opponent.label: Saria
opponent.description: The Sage of Forest, Saria has traveled far and wide with the end of the Gohma Wars. She has traveled beyond Hyrule, and found herself at the Inventory. Unlike her namesake in Ocarina of Time, this Saria has lost the blessing of the Great Deku Tree after it's death, and has embraced the opportunity to age and explore the greater world under the grace of the Three Goddesses.
